dog.description_text:
Meet Brooklyn, an affectionate and loving cat!

Brooklyn has soft fur and adoring eyes that are sure to draw you in. One of our favorite things about Brooklyn is how much she loves receiving affection. She'll happily burrow her head into your hands for pets, making it clear that cuddles and attention are some of her favorite things in the world. Brooklyn is also wonderfully social. She loves having company and enjoys spending time with her favorite people, whether she's soaking up pets or simply keeping you company throughout the day.

As for hobbies, Brooklyn enjoys collecting head scratches and spending time with those she loves. She's always ready for a petting session and thrives on the attention of her human friends. Brooklyn is also bonded to her best friend, Bronx, and the two make a wonderful pair who enjoy sharing life's comforts together.

Ready to meet the delightful Brooklyn and her bestie Bronx? Click the “Adopt Me” button to get in touch with us!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
